title: AI / LLM Engineer
description: Synthetic role: build grounded document assistants with retrieval and measurable evaluation. Demonstrate Python engineering, RAG design, handling unsupported answers and evaluation of failure cases. Expected experience: at least 2 years of relevant AI application engineering.
screening_criteria: Build and test Python AI application services.
Implement retrieval-augmented generation and explain evidence grounding.
Evaluate LLM output quality, unsupported answers and instruction attacks.
At least 2 years of relevant AI application engineering.

questions.text: How did you choose retrieval and chunking methods for a document assistant?
How would you test unsupported answers and instructions embedded in documents?
Describe your Python ownership and the duration of your AI application work.
